title: The Black Moor
author: O. Kirkland
description: A compact horror fantasy scenario for four players, full of swamp secrets, cursed relics, and choices that change every night.

title: Glass Library
author: Maia Vale
description: A heist-style urban adventure with hidden archives, rival factions, and a stolen spell that can rewrite memory.

title: Atlas of Cinders
author: J. N. Rook
description: A short bundle of ruined city encounters, fire-touched beasts, and optional sandbox hooks for street-level exploration.

title: Moonlit Market
author: E. Sparrow
description: A market night scenario built around bargains, strange artifacts, and the cost of making a wish after dark.

title: Starbound Brief
author: A. Redfern
description: A lightweight science-fantasy download with starship salvage, mysterious coordinates, and an urgent call to action.
